content.label:
This is generally a friendly and useful app with lots of guidance, stats and health content which I used to use every day. 
Since updating to iOS 27 it’s become almost unusable unfortunately. It will often load with blank screens and spinners, with no history of health or activities, which then blocks access to anything and everything. It also makes my iPhone 17 Pro run very very hot. None of this was fixed after a delete and reinstall either and it’s very unfortunate that my annual subscription renewed a few weeks ago.
Hoping the developers are working on a fix to make the app usable again.

I’ve been up and down with  this app the last two years but it is genuinely good at what it does. The free version is generous enough for you to give it a try and i recommend you do. 

Quite possibly the best fitness app available on iOS.
Definitely the best health & fitness app for the average person.
Thanks!

I have now been using GS for over 2 yrs since major surgery for Coronary bypass. It has helped me maintain a healthy balance of exercise with recovery periods. I like the ability to set down time for periods of rest.

I didn’t realise I had been pushing so hard in my exercise and that it wasn’t helping me achieve my goals! Gentler has helped join the dots between my running, my exhaustion and my frustration.

I now have a clearer path to improving my fitness and better motivation to turn to a range of activities. The compassionate view the app offers with breaks for rest and recovery gives me a lot of confidence that this app is supporting me, not just optimising numbers.

Excited to have found such a great use for all that health data at last!
This is a fantastic supportive app.  Not too complex and easy to use.
Great app certainly keeps me moving which is not always easy at my age i’m 76
I’ve found since signing up to gentler streak I am encouraged to exercise more. Feeling the spaciousness of resting is always an option makes another stretch of exercise easy to choose. Thank you

it’s amazing how closely the gentler streak team listens to its users, all updates feel necessary and innovative. and the gentle mindset helped me change my routine in other habits too, like hobbies and language learning, for the better.
Been using this for a while now and I love it. Definitely worth getting the subscription/ membership. Great widgets as well for iPhones at least. Highly recommended :)

I loved this app and used it for over a year and recommended to my athletic sister. But now I’m pregnant and despite changing that on my period setting it keeps nudging me asking why I’m less active. I thought it would take that into account but it me not really. It’s making me feel rubbish because it’s not taking that into consideration, when I haven’t slept well the Gentler emoji shows something different or is kinder but at this point i might just delete the app. Can this be made into a new edit?!

I found this app while looking for a fitness/health tracker for my wife, who has Fibromyalgia and probable CFS/ME. I tested it out, and confirmed it was ideal for her, but now I’m also hooked for a completely different reason.

I’m 55 and have Autism Spectrum Disorder, which for me means that I can become obsessed with whatever I’m working on to the exclusion of everything else. When it comes to fitness, that means I’ve pushed myself to dangerous efforts because the apps I was using told me to. Closing rings, increasing pace, that kind of thing.

Gentler Streak gives me clear information based on real measured vitals and suggests what would be _right_ for me each day. I’m not an athlete training for an international event, so I have now stopped using the apps that pretend I am 😂

Fantastic work to the whole team - this is a real breath of fresh air (pun intended)!

title.label: Really nice app but getting really slow to load

content.label: Feels like it takes a full minute before I see the Home Screen. Never used to be like this. On the latest Pro phone and not low power mode.
Not working. Unable to log that a period has already happened, just default to logging it as today.

Had this app for about 3 years and it just gets better and better . I am 62 and it motivates me to go out and run and to know I am not overtraining . It’s nice that it gives gentle encouragement and suggestions like dog walking etc .. . It not always about running marathons which is nice, and this has definitely made me fitter . Than you .

I’ve never met an app which was so impossible to use without being aggressively pestered for purchases. The negativity this generates is really intense. I shall probably have to delete it quite soon to save my sanity.

I rarely leave reviews as I don’t use an app long enough but with gentler streak I’m on my 3rd year. It’s such a good app, everything in one place, doesn’t nag when you are feeling like not doing as much. Easy to track your progress. Everything about it simply works really, really well. You can tell the developers have thought about every detail. Such good value for money that I now never use the Apple fitness app. It’s straight to gentler streak. I cannot praise it enough, it’s really helped with my fitness and doesn’t make me feel like I’m not doing enough. Please never change 🤗
Watch app not tracking heartbeat maybe since new ios update? Worked flawlessly before

title.label: A great app, but still growing

content.label:
I have used Gentler Streak since 2022 and I’m generally really happy with the product and I’m excited for what it will become in the future. 

It does not work well with Garmin for those who wonder which is its only negative for me - but it’s flawless with Apple Watch.

I’m the sort of person that needs gentle encouragement. I’ve done the whole bullying myself into fitness and it doesn’t stick. So I was a bit worried using an app that had the ability to guilt me. Gentler streak does not. 

What compelled me to write this review is that I’ve just come back from having a chest infection, and I was a little bit worried that when I changed back to active mode that the app would start haranguing me about not doing enough exercise and not being in my active path. The reality couldn’t be further from the truth; it’s been really gently reminding me that I still need to take it easy, and actually if I just do a gentle walk that’s enough. It’s just so perfectly tuned, I love it!

title.label: Great fitness app tailored to you!

content.label: I spent ages looking for a fitness app that would suggest workouts for you based on what you’ve done recently and how you’re currently feeling, and Gentler Streak is exactly that. The app is super intuitive and easy to use, really helpful, makes good workout suggestions and is very encouraging! Also nice to look at. I purchased the subscription a couple of months ago and haven’t regretted it, it’s been super helpful for staying fit and learning to understand my own body. I also really appreciate that you can set your status to injured or sick so you’re not feeling pressured to work out when you’re not ready for it! I would highly recommend this app to anyone interested in looking after themselves :)
I was in two minds to get the paid subscription or not but this app is a game changer, don’t think twice. Apple should take inspiration from them!

title.label: Stopped my subscription and they closed my account early

content.label: Terrible experience

Fantastic analytics and user interface. Apple Watch companion app is great too. I love the workouts like house chores and walk the dogs. But until there is stava integration I have to use the default workout app on Apple Watch rather than gentler steak app. Once that issue is fixed then I’d use it!

I don’t know if the app is good or not because as soon as I tried to use there was no trial period. Instead I was hit with banners of subscriptions that kept changing price every few hours. I did not know what to do! It was so confusing.
Also after these varying prices disappeared I was left with a price of £54.99 to pay and no other option, this is not in line with their pricing advertised on the Apple Store, I am 1 person and there should be an option of £24.99 and there isn’t ! Go gentler this is not good enough and misleading. How can I trust the app if I can’t trust the developer. A word of advice, make your pricing structure honest and consistent and remove even else. You will have a lot more customers

title.label: Doesn’t give good feedback and targets

content.label: I’ve been using Gentler Streak (paid version) for over two years now and this will be my last. I had an injury and marked myself as injured and it kept nagging me telling me ‘you’re losing your streak’ then it’s now going to you’re extending your limits and telling me to stop. Utterly pointless app now, whatever updates some genius has done have ruined it.

Both my wife and I have been using this app for a few months now and are loving it.

I have a tendency to “do fitness” in fits and spurts: lurching from overtraining to spending rather longer than I should eating pizza and drinking beer.

This app is gently helping me to keep my training regular, varied and manageable.

It truly is a superb app.

title.label: New update causing app to crash showing wellbeing

content.label:
Usually I would give this 4/5 (loses a point for not showing an in the moment readiness to train). Really encourages me to be sensible training.
New update that has changed how wellbeing shows is continually crashing the app on iPhone. No other way to bring this to attention of developer than writing this review so has effectively stopped me from using app

I do like this app so far but I feel the cost of all features is too expensive. Also the watch widgets don’t work unless I actively open it every day which defeats the object of the widget functionality in my opinion. Bonus star for no crummy adverts though, one of the very few apps out there today that doesn’t interrupt you every five seconds for a falsely advertised game 👍🏻

title.label: Great app but stop asking me to prolong the subscription

content.label: I really enjoy the app but recently the pop-up ad of extending the subscription is so annoying. I am already a paid customer and the subscription won’t expire until June next year. Why the hell you need to send me reminders every time I open the app? Sometimes you can’t even close the pop-up. I paid the subscription to avoid the ads not being reminded to it. Product team really needs to rethink about this feature otherwise I will consider alternatives once the subscription ends.

title.label: Fabulous app for pacing with fibromyalgia/ cfs/me

content.label:
My daughter found this app and recommended it to me to me due to the above conditions and me repeatedly NOT pacing properly and ‘pushing through’.  
The app is clear and helpful, showing when to slow down and also when I can actually try and do some movement but gentle movement when coming out of a flare. This is very difficult to do as a fibro sufferer. I’ve had it for many years and have never felt comfortable with resting when I need it. But I have been using this app for one month now and I can truly say it’s worth every penny! I definitely recommend anyone in a similar position with autoimmune issues to download and try it. I don’t think you will regret it. 
Thanks for the work you all do on the app. I appreciate it very much.

title.label: Wonderful app and great customer service

content.label: Highly recommend
Such an amazing and refreshing way to track fitness and exercise, letting you take rest days etc, without sending you notifications that you should be exercising. Would highly recommend to anyone

The most pointless of pointless apps - and there’s quite the list to choose from. It does absolutely nothing that the average smart watch doesn’t already tell you. It tells you to take a rest? Your own body and common sense tell you that. This app also affects the data gathered in Apple Health when used by other apps. Save you’re money and avoid.
Since noticed it also kills the heart rate recovery feature in Apple Health.
Snake oil sales company.

I downloaded this so I could try out the Live Activity mirror feature for my indoor rowing. 

However the try 1 session free didn’t work so I bit the bullet and paid for a subscription. But it didn’t work for me. The heart rate stayed at 79bpm even though the HR on the watch was 118. The mirror also disappeared at one point and there was no way to get it back. Disappointed as this was the main reason for me to try this. Maybe it hasn’t been tested with older Apple Watches?

I’ll try a few more times, but if this continues I’ll be seeking a refund. 

Lovely design though.
Way too expensive given you still have to pay for everything else that it’ll recommend you to do

title.label: Beautiful design and motivates me to workout

content.label:
Nowadays we have several different similar apps next to OS’s default apps, but what makes Gentler better than others for me its design. It feels me like a cute friend who has my back and always interests to see me and show me the way that I worked out with beautiful chars, numbers, etc.
I haven’t paid yet and I’m on trial period and I’m hoping it can convince me that I’m not wrong.
Anyway I want to express my gratitude for this best design that you chose to be in.
Love you xoxo.

I’d love to try this app out but so much is behind a paywall that unfortunately I can’t. Looks interesting but you should be able to test out the functionality more before having to purchase. Disappointingly going to have to uninstall.

title.label: Awful paywall introduced in an otherwise great app

content.label: Hi Gentler Streak team! I loved your app and has been an active user for a long time. The functionality used to be excellent and worked amazing with my Apple Watch. However, the new strict paywall has blocked access to all the features I enjoyed so much. Viewing the 30- or 10-day activity path? Saving perceived exertion? Checking your HRV? Forget it - everything’s now hidden behind a paywall. After using all these features for such a long time, this is really unexpected and disappointing. I strongly believe that you should only introduce paywall for new features, not something that’s been in place for months. I will now switch back to Apple Workouts & Health as there is almost no difference between the free version of your product and Apple’s.

Got this app today, have tried many fitness/hr trackers over the years, this looks interesting, however the app soon asks for £90 for family membership which is reduced 50% from £179.99!, I can’t see any price for individual membership, either in the App Store or in the app. Day two using limited free version: App shows me completely different charts for same workout this morning on my iPhone and on my iPad. Reduced to 2*. Both days 3 and 4 app advises I am overworking and to have a rest day. This cannot be right. I am getting back to exercise after a Xmas cold, and perceived exertion is deliberately low. 24hr offer is gone app now laughable full price £179.99 for up to 5 people. That may suit some. But the app concept is good and the app UI is glossy. Deleted.
it keeps telling me I'm dying even when I'm young, fit, healthy, have been sleeping well and have just gone for a nice slow walk outdoors

Not entirely sure what it does more than Apple’s “Health” app. It just takes the data from there and other apps to display it in a different way. Maybe there’s more to it but I’m definitely not buying an annual subscription to find out 🤣 waste of time.

title.label: At my age and for the grand children

content.label:
I have found this great application which is ideal for my own needs and efforts to maintain a good form and strength for longevity, especially as I am 79.

Why, well the normal enlightening points and tests from my doctor as well as visual signs expressed by my mirror and clothes.

So a wake up call a few months ago - where are those muscles going etc. - care and attention needed! I should have realised earlier.

Actually I am now watching my diet and nutrients as well as doing my exercises with this app, providing beneficial movement instead of relaxing. It is more than a game but that is how I am treating it and enjoying it.

Hopefully reading this will give all ages encouragement to look after their bodies and see the benefits in using this app especially.

I really do wish I’d found this app sooner. Seeing my health data laid out like this every morning. And knowing how my body is ready for workout and how hard I can safely push. Knowing I’m healthy or if something is amiss, I could write an essay. Truly fantastic. And the customer service teams are exemplary. Thank you.
Like a personal trainer in your pocket. Great for helping guide me as a beginner!

According to this I am overreaching simply just by going to work. I am in bed at 7pm and up at 4am. I check the app and it says am overarching. I work in retail. I then have a 40 minute gym session. Still overreaching. I also have two rest days. Absolutely no way that’s too much. Going by this I should just stay in bed. Rubbish.

title.label: Far to expensive and not much on offer

content.label:
It is clear now that for a sizeable monthly fee you don’t really get anymore than the much improved Apple workout app gives you..
It is far to expensive and I struggle to see what benefit the cost offers me?
Deleted!

Was interested to try this out, but no trial was offered - and 95% of the app’s functionality is hidden behind a paywall.  

The annual fee is considerable, so shelling out a considerable amount of money on an app I can’t even try out is not going to happen. 

Sadly, it was therefore deleted a day after installing.

I’m loving using the app but clumsy fingers mean I sometimes record workouts accidentally on my watch or forgot to end them. I’ve tried but can’t see a way to delete incorrect data.  Am I missing something?
